Name: Old Dominion Freight Line Inc
Description: Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc. (ODFL) is a premier American less-than-truckload (LTL) carrier that excels in providing a comprehensive range of freight services across regional, inter-regional, and national networks. Known for its operational excellence, the company offers a diverse suite of logistics solutions, including expedited transportation, supply chain consulting, transportation management, truckload brokerage, and warehousing services. With a steadfast commitment to customer satisfaction and a focus on innovative, technology-driven strategies, Old Dominion Freight Line is well-positioned to continue its growth trajectory in the competitive transportation sector.
